learning_outcomes.text: Understand the principles of effective teaching and teaching IT in Primary and Secondary Education.
Learn teaching methods for use in subjects on general algorithms and programming.
Learn innovative methods for teaching programming.
Learn about software used for IT in Primary, Middle School, High School/Lyceum and Professional Lyceum.
Effectively plan teachings for Computer Science and Informatics topics using worksheets.
Design and implement teaching scenarios on IT in a school environment (Primary and Secondary Education).
Use and integrate educational software into the teaching process.

syllabus_topics: Informatics as a subject and a cognitive tool.

Informatics as a subject in the Greek educational system (Computer Science in Primary School, Middle School, High School/Lyceum and Vocational Education - Basic axes of teaching, Curriculum, Syllabus)
Teaching and teaching of Informatics: conceptual framework
Learning Theories, Didactic Models, Didactic Techniques (Didactic Transformation of Concepts of Computer Science, Mental Models and Representations of Informatics)

Teaching design, educational scenarios, didactic interventions. (Exploiting Logo-like and Scratch-like Environments, Role Playing, Computer Games, Educational Robotics - Using NXT Lego Robots, Arduino).

Programming instruction (Teaching methods for teaching programming concepts, types of knowledge in programming, Modern technological environments for introductory programming and computational thinking).
Teaching of software for educational purposes.
teaching_methods: Use of projector and board during lectures
Course website maintenance (announcements, communication with students, posting teaching material)
Use of suitable software for teaching algorithms-programming

assessment_methods.method: Final written examination (multiple choice, short-answer, open-ended questions, problem solving)
Laboratory work (Design of teaching scenarios and worksheets)

assessment_rules: The final written examination assesses theoretical knowledge and the ability to design teaching scenarios and course plans. Laboratory work assesses the design of teaching scenarios and worksheets, encouraging modern teaching methods and suggestions for developing worksheets for programming and algorithms. The evaluation procedure is accessible to students via the course website.
